layoutHintAbnt: Your keyboard looks like ABNT2 (it has Ç).
layoutHintIntl: Your keyboard looks like US International, with dead keys.

accents: Use accents in quotes and free run
collSummary: {n} of {t} unlocked. Reach the goals to awaken Stands, Evas, Titans and weapons.
homeTips: Your index fingers rest on F and J. Feel the bump on those keys.
Each finger owns the keys of its color.
After each key, the finger goes back to the home row.
Look at the screen, not at your hands.
Sit up straight, feet on the floor, relaxed wrists.
Accuracy first. Speed comes with practice.
homeKeyLine: {k}: {f}. This key is on the home row.
reachLine: {k}: {f}. The finger leaves {h}, presses {k} and returns to {h}.
in_fj: Your index fingers rest on F and J. Those keys have a bump so you can find them without looking.
The other fingers sit next to them: A S D on the left hand, K L {p} on the right.
After each key, the finger goes back to the home row.
in_a: Left hand: pinky on A, ring on S, middle on D, index on F.
Right hand: index on J, middle on K, ring on L, pinky on {p}.
Each finger owns the keys of its color on the screen keyboard.
in_r1: You now know the whole home row.
Try not to look at the screen keyboard either. You can hide it in Progress, Settings.
in_shift: To type a capital letter, hold Shift with the pinky of the other hand.
Left-hand letter (like D): right Shift. Right-hand letter (like J): left Shift.
Release Shift right after the letter.
in_q: Comma and period sit on the bottom row, right hand.
The capital at the start of a sentence also uses Shift.
in_q_intl: Comma and period sit on the bottom row, right hand.
The capital at the start of a sentence also uses Shift.
Quotes and apostrophe are dead keys: press Space after them.
in_x_gh: G and H sit in the middle. The index fingers stretch sideways.
in_x_ei: Move only the finger. Keep the hand still.
in_x_nm: On the bottom row, the finger moves down and comes back.
in_x_qp: The pinkies are the weakest fingers. Go slowly.
tipSlow: Slow down. Hit the right key first, then go faster.
tipRhythm: Great accuracy! Now try to keep a steady rhythm, without pauses.
tipKey: You missed {k} the most. That key belongs to the {f}.
setupIntro: Before you start, let's find out your keyboard and pick your anime.
setupStep1: Press the key right after L. On ABNT2 it is Ç, on US it is ;.
setupStep2: Now press the single quote key ', right after the previous key.
setupWrong1: That is not the key. Look for the one right after L.
setupWrong2: That is not the key. Look for the single quote ', right after ;.
setupNeedLayout: First press the keys above or choose your keyboard.
layoutHintUs: Your keyboard looks like US without dead keys.
in_acc_us: The US keyboard without dead keys cannot type accents.
In this lesson the words show up without accents. To practice accents, use the US Intl or ABNT2 layout.
pausedOverlay: Paused. Click here and press a key to continue.
freeLimited: For now, the free run uses only the keys you already know: {k}. All letters unlock after lesson {n}.
quotesLocked: Quotes unlock after lesson {n} (Capitals with Shift). Until then, you can preview them.
footer: Progress is saved in this browser.
setupNameHint: It shows on the home screen and in the standings.
failedAcc: Almost! To pass, you need {n}% accuracy.
in_acc1_intl: On US International, an accent is a dead key: nothing shows until you press the letter.
' and then A makes á. ~ and then A makes ã.
To type the apostrophe alone, press ' and then Space.
in_acc2_intl: Shift+6 (^) and then E makes ê.
` (the key left of 1) and then A makes à.
For Ç, hold AltGr and press the comma.
in_acc1_abnt: On ABNT2, an accent is a dead key: nothing shows until you press the letter.
´ and then A makes á. ~ and then A makes ã.
in_acc2_abnt: Shift + ~ makes ^ (for ê). Shift + ´ makes ` (for à).
Ç has its own key, under the right little finger.
